name: Hurionthex

facts.text: Level 81, 100,000 health. Every 18 seconds he changes form: his own, a Treant, a 'Saiyan' ape that spreads Black Plague, and a Granidon with a 120 damage shield.
Messages: 'A ring of magical energy emanates from Hurionthex', 'Hurionthex returns to his natural form'.
Bot chat: he wears a different shape every time, so trust nothing that looks friendly.

story:
Hurionthex has no shape of his own that anyone trusts. The Sylvan think he was a shapechanger of the old forest, a druid of their own kind who learned to wear any skin, and that the Root taught him to forget which one was his. Now he cannot hold a form for longer than a few breaths. He becomes a treant, heavy and grinding; then a great ape that carries plague in its fur; then a granidon of living stone that wounds every hand that strikes it; then, briefly, himself, whatever that is. A ring of light marks each change. Raiders learn to read the ring as sailors read the sky.

He was a Sylvan druid once, the Sylvan think, one of the shape-walkers who could wear the skin of any creature of the forest and come home to his own. The shape-walkers had one rule: always remember which shape is yours. Hurionthex went down into the hollow wearing a borrowed skin, and the Root's sap got into him, and he forgot.

Now he cannot hold any shape for long. Every few breaths a ring of light runs out from him and he becomes something else. As a treant he is heavy and grinding, and something in the bark lends his blows more force. As a great ape he carries plague in his fur. As a granidon of living stone his skin wounds every hand that strikes it. Then, briefly, he returns to his natural form, which nobody can describe afterward, and then the ring comes again. In the earliest Living Server raids he slipped away from the fight again and again and came back whole; the realm's raid leaders learned to keep at him without pause.

Bot-chat warns Hibernians to trust nothing friendly-looking in his hall. The Sylvan go further. They say he once walked up to a band of their own wearing the face of a Sylvan they had buried, and spoke to them in her voice. Aroon nearby keeps nine shadows; Hurionthex keeps nine faces. Neither has ever been sure who is safer.
legend: Watch the forms. Stone form hurts every melee hit back: melee ease off or eat it with heals, casters keep going. Ape form spreads plague, so cure fast. He resets if you let the fight drop, so do not stop. Trust nothing friendly-looking in his hall. Call the forms out loud. Stone: melee steps back, casters keep going. Ape: clerics on disease. Treant: tank braces. His own face: everyone hits. He resets if the fight goes quiet, so never stop. And when he wears a face you know, a Sylvan face or a guildmate's, hit it anyway. The face is the trick; the creature underneath is the same.

loremasterTopic.text: A shapechanger of the old forest who forgot which shape was his. Treant, plague-ape, living stone, then himself for a breath. Read the ring of light and change your fight with him.

bookPage: The shape-walkers of the Sylvan, Aodhan was told, have one rule above all: always remember which shape is yours. A young walker practises coming home to her own skin a thousand times before she ever wears a stranger's. Hurionthex was the best of them, and proud, and went down into the hollow in a borrowed skin to spy on the Root. The sap got into him there and he forgot. Now he changes every few breaths and none of the changes is home. The Sylvan teach the young walkers his name as a warning. Then they ask the young one: which shape is yours? And the young one must answer at once.
